s: Sharding, replication, partitioning, connection pooling, read replicas
d: When your database becomes the bottleneck, you need scaling strategies. Read replicas handle read-heavy loads. Sharding distributes data across servers. Connection pooling prevents exhausting connections. These are critical senior-level skills.

p: As applications grow, a single database server will bottleneck. Database scaling involves distributing the load across multiple machines to ensure fast read/write speeds.
1. Vertical Scaling: Buy a bigger server (more RAM/CPU). Limits apply.
2. Read Replicas: One Master for Writes, multiple Replicas for Reads.
3. Sharding (Horizontal): Splitting the database table across multiple servers based on a Shard Key (e.g., user_id).
